title: Update on Clean-up Work Following Pasir Panjang Terminal Oil Spill Incident
what_it_is: Update on Clean-up Work Following Pasir Panjang Terminal Oil Spill Incident

sections.label: Oil spill beach clean-up status
sections.summary: The first clean-up phase is complete, the second is underway, some beaches have re-opened, and all affected beaches are planned to be cleaned within about one month.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment whether an update can be provided on the status of the clean-up work on our beaches and coastal areas which had to be carried out following the oil spill at the Pasir Panjang Terminal on 14 June 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We have completed the first phase of the clean-up.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The second phase of the clean-up which focuses on difficult-to-clean areas like rock bunds, breakwaters and oil trapped deeper in the sand is well underway.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Some beaches have progressed to the final phase, where volunteers are mobilised to participate in the clean-up and accelerate the re-opening of the beaches.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As of today, Siloso Beach at Sentosa has re-opened for all water activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Several parts of East Coast Park have re-opened for land-based activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We plan to complete the cleaning of all affected beaches within the next one month or so.

sections.label: Assistance to businesses update
sections.summary: The Government says it is focusing on the cleaning-up, and that estimating losses and other business considerations are not related to Mr Dennis Tan's Parliamentary Question.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Can the Government provide an update of the assistance which the Government has been rendering to these businesses so far?

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We are focusing our attention on the actual cleaning-up which I think deserves our priority and also our urgent attention.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As to estimation of losses and also updates on other business considerations, I think this is not related to the Parliamentary Question that Mr Dennis Tan had filed.
